projectBackground.name: Regional Depot Building — Foundations
projectBackground.context: You support the site manager on foundations. Quantities and quality records must be right before pours.

manager.name: Ingrid Solberg
manager.note: Right quantity, right quality, written down. If it's not recorded it didn't happen.

tasks.title: Concrete Order
tasks.prompt: Slab 20 m x 12 m x 0.25 m, with 5% waste allowance. What volume should you order (m3)?
tasks.reasoning: Order slightly over to avoid shortfall.
tasks.mistake: Ordering exact volume risks a cold joint.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Loose Volume
tasks.prompt: Excavating 30 m x 10 m x 2.5 m with 25% bulking. What is the loose volume to haul (m3)?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Truck Loads
tasks.prompt: Each truck carries 10 m3 loose. How many loads for 937.5 m3 (round up)?
tasks.mistake: Rounding down leaves soil on site.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Cube Strength (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Strength in column D (N/mm2) = load (kN) x 1000 / area (mm2).
tasks.mistake: Mixing kN and N gives values 1,000 times off.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Non-Conformance Report
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence non-conformance report for cover to reinforcement found at 25 mm against a 40 mm specification.
tasks.modelAnswer: During pre-pour inspection of foundation F3 on Monday, cover to the bottom reinforcement measured 25 mm against the 40 mm specified. The pour was stopped and the area isolated. Spacers will be replaced and the reinforcement re-inspected before release. I recommend a toolbox talk on spacer use and a recheck of adjacent foundations.
tasks.reasoning: A good NCR states what, where, the requirement, the action and prevention.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Short Cover
caseStudy.background: A slab was poured with 20 mm cover instead of 40 mm. Cores later showed corrosion risk and a 300,000 repair.
caseStudy.solution: Vertex added cover meters and sign-offs before every pour.
